name: MailSentra: Email Logging & Diagnostics
author: Macro Espias

sections.description:
MailSentra logs WordPress email attempts and records the status, recipient, subject, trigger, caller, call stack, and source details for each message. It provides email statistics, weekly and monthly reports, source-based diagnostics, search and filtering, CSV export, and configurable retention.

Email body, headers, attachment paths, and request IP addresses can be logged when their individual settings are enabled. Email bodies and headers are optional, and IP logging is optional. MailSentra stores logged data in the site database and does not send it to an external service.

A “Sent” status means WordPress or PHPMailer reported a successful send operation. It does not confirm final inbox delivery or rule out a later bounce.

Developer structure

Plugin PHP files are grouped by responsibility under includes/: database code is in Database/, mail capture is in Logging/, privacy-related code is in Security/, and the WordPress admin interface is in Admin/. Dashboard reporting and Tools page logic are in Admin/Pages/, with the Tools page markup in Admin/Views/tools/. The main plugin file explicitly loads these modules; keep the loader paths in sync when moving or adding PHP files.

Features

  • Logs wp_mail() send attempts.
  • Records sent/failed result from WordPress mail hooks.
  • Dashboard statistics.
  • Seven-day activity chart.
  • Search and status filtering.
  • Detailed individual log view.
  • Manual resend as a new attempt from log details when the original message body was captured.
  • CSV export.
  • Configurable body/header/attachment logging.
  • Configurable retention period.
  • Optional database cleanup on uninstall.

Important

A “Sent” status means WordPress invoked its mail-success hook or a pre-send integration returned true. WordPress invokes the mail-success hook after PHPMailer returns normally, even if its send result is false, so this status does not guarantee successful transport or final inbox delivery. Check your mail provider’s logs for delivery confirmation.

MailSentra writes each log to the WordPress database before the mail attempt and updates its status from WordPress mail hooks. If a log write fails, email sending continues and MailSentra records a generic diagnostic in the PHP error log. Logging depends on the site’s database being available; a database outage or interrupted request can still prevent a log from being stored or leave it pending.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to MailSentra > Settings.
  4. Configure logging options.
sections.faq:
Does a Sent status confirm inbox delivery?

No. It means WordPress and PHPMailer reported a successful send operation. It does not confirm final delivery or rule out a later bounce.

What does Pending mean?

The email attempt was logged, but MailSentra has not recorded a sent or failed result yet. This can happen while sending or if the result hook does not run.

Where are email logs stored?

Logs are stored in this site’s WordPress database. MailSentra does not send logged data to an external service. Configure the logged fields and retention period in MailSentra > Settings.

2.0.1

  • Split admin styles into shared and page-specific Dashboard, Tools, and Settings stylesheets, and enqueue the matching files on each page.
  • Added complementary blue and gray top borders to the Email Activity chart and Email Reports panels.

  • Added a Tools page with a protected test email form and developer-focused send diagnostics, including available PHPMailer errors, transport configuration, and troubleshooting suggestions.
